an5.192:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho doṇo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an5.192:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.192:2.2: “na samaṇo gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetī”ti.
an5.192:2.4: na hi bhavaṃ gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetīti.
an5.192:2.7: yaṃ hi taṃ bho gotama sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an5.192:2.9: mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, ajjhāyako mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo”ti mameva taṃ bho gotama sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
an5.192:2.10: ahaṃ hi bho gotama brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto
an5.192:2.11: mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena. ajjhāyako mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako veyyākaraṇo, lokāyata mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayoti.
an5.192:3.1: ye kho te doṇa, brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo - mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesañcidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti, tadanubhāsanti, bhāsitamanubhāsanti, sajjhāyitamanusajjhāyanti,* vācitamanuvācenti, seyyathīdaṃ: aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu.
an5.192:3.3: brahmasamaṃ, devasamaṃ, mariyādaṃ, sambhinnamariyādaṃ, brāhmaṇa caṇḍālaṃ yeva pañcamaṃ.
an5.192:4.1: na kho mayaṃ bho gotama, ime pañca brāhmaṇe jānāma. atha kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇātveva jānāma.
an5.192:4.2: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ahaṃ ime pañca brāhmaṇe jāneyyanti.
an5.192:4.3: tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇohi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
an5.192:4.4: evaṃ hoti kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an5.192:5.2: idha doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:5.3: mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:5.4: so aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno
an5.192:5.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammeneva, no adhammena.
an5.192:6.2: neva kasiyā, na vaṇijjāya, na gorakkhena, na issatthena na rājaporisena na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:6.3: so ācariyassa ācariya dhanaṃ niyyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an5.192:6.4: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthiṃ - iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhī sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an5.192:6.7: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthiṃ - iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhī sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an5.192:6.8: so ime cattāro brahmavihāre bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ brahmalokaṃ uppajjati.
an5.192:6.9: evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo brahmasamo hoti.
an5.192:7.2: idha doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:7.3: mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:7.4: so aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno.
an5.192:7.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammeneva no adhammena.
an5.192:7.7: neva kasiyā, na vaṇijjāya, na gorakkhena, na issatthena, na rājaporisena, na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:7.8: so ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammeneva no adhammena.
an5.192:8.2: neva kayena, na vikkayena, brāhmaṇiṃ yeva udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:8.3: so brāhmaṇiṃ yeva gacchati. na khattiyiṃ. na vessiṃ, na suddiṃ, na caṇḍāliṃ, na nesādiṃ, na veṇiṃ, na rathakāriṃ, na pukkusiṃ gacchati. na gabbhiniṃ gacchati, na pāyamānaṃ gacchati, na anutuniṃ gacchati.
an5.192:8.4: kasmā ca doṇa brāhmaṇo na gabbhiniṃ gacchati:
an5.192:8.5: sace doṇa brāhmaṇo gabbhiniṃ gacchati, atimīḷhajo nāma so hoti māṇavako vā māṇavikā vā.
an5.192:8.6: tasmā doṇa brāhmaṇo na gabbhiniṃ gacchati.
an5.192:8.7: kasmā ca doṇa brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati:
an5.192:8.8: sace doṇa brāhmaṇo pāyamānaṃ gacchati, asuci paṭipīto nāma so hoti māṇavako vā māṇavikā vā.
an5.192:8.9: tasmā doṇa brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati. kasmā ca doṇa brāhmaṇo na anutuniṃ gacchati: sace doṇa brāhmaṇo anutuniṃ gacchati
an5.192:8.10: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī neva kāmatthā na davatthā na ratatthā, pajatthāva brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
an5.192:8.11: so mithunaṃ uppādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an5.192:8.12: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno vivicceva kāmehi catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.192:8.13: so ime cattāro jhāne bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.192:8.14: evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo devasamo hoti.
an5.192:9.2: idha doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:9.3: mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:9.4: so aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno.
an5.192:9.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammeneva no adhammena.
an5.192:9.7: neva kasiyā, na vaṇijjāya, na gorakkhena, na issatthena, na rājaporisena, na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:9.8: so ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammeneva no adhammena.
an5.192:10.2: neva kayena, na vikkayena, brāhmaṇiṃ yeva udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:10.3: so brāhmaṇiṃ yeva gacchati, na khattiyiṃ, na vessiṃ, na suddiṃ, na caṇḍāliṃ, na nesādiṃ, na veṇiṃ, na rathakāriṃ, na pukkusiṃ gacchati. na gabbhiniṃ gacchati. na pāyamānaṃ gacchati na anutuniṃ gacchati.
an5.192:10.4: kasmā ca doṇa brāhmaṇo na gabbhiniṃ gacchati?
an5.192:10.5: sace doṇa brāhmaṇo gabbhiniṃ gacchati …pe… pajatthā va
an5.192:10.11: so mithunaṃ uppādetvā tameva puttassādaṃ nikāmayamāno kuṭumbaṃ ajjhāvasati, na agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an5.192:10.12: yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā, tattha tiṭṭhati, taṃ na vītikkamati
an5.192:10.13: ‘yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādo tattha brāhmaṇo ṭhito taṃ na vītikkamatī’ti kho doṇa tasmā “brāhmaṇo mariyādo” ti vuccati.
an5.192:10.14: evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo mariyādo hoti.
an5.192:11.2: idha doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:11.4: so aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno.
an5.192:11.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati, dhammeneva no adhammena.
an5.192:12.2: neva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena, na rājaporisena, na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:12.3: so ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammena’pi adhammena’pi. kayena’pi vikkayena’pi brāhmaṇimpi udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:12.4: so brāhmaṇimpi gacchati, khattiyimpi gacchati, vessimpi gacchati, suddimpi gacchati, caṇḍālimpi gacchati, nesādimpi gacchati, veṇimpi gacchati, rathakārimpi gacchati, pukkusimpi gacchati, gabhinimpi gacchati, pāyamānampi gacchati, utunimpi gacchati, anutunimpi gacchati,
an5.192:12.5: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī kāmatthāpi davatthāpi ratatthāpi. na pajatthāva brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
an5.192:12.6: yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā, tattha na tiṭṭhati, taṃ vītikkamati.
an5.192:12.7: ‘yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā tattha brāhmaṇo na ṭhito, taṃ vītikkamatī’ti kho doṇa tasmā “brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo” ti vuccati.
an5.192:12.8: evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo hoti.
an5.192:13.1: kathañca doṇa, brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇa caṇḍālo hoti?
an5.192:13.2: idha doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:13.3: mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:13.4: so aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno.
an5.192:13.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammena’pi adhammena’pi
an5.192:13.6: kasiyā’pi vaṇijjāya’pi gorakkhena’pi issatthena’pi rājaporisena’pi sippaññatarena’pi kevalampi bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:14.1: so ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammena’pi adhammena’pi kayena’pi vikkayena’pi udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:14.2: so brāhmaṇimpi gacchati, khattiyimpi gacchati, vessimpi gacchati, suddimpi gacchati, caṇḍālimpi gacchati, nesādimpi gacchati, veṇimpi gacchati rathakārimpi gacchati, pukkusimpi gacchati, gabbhinimpi gacchati, pāyamānampi gacchati, utunimpi gacchati, anutunimpi gacchati
an5.192:14.3: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī kāmatthāpi davatthāpi ratatthāpi, na pajatthāva brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
an5.192:14.6: “kasmā bhavaṃ brāhmaṇo paṭijānamāno sabbakammehi jīvikaṃ kappeti?”ti.
an5.192:14.8: “seyyathāpi bho aggi sucimpi dahati, asucimpi dahati na ca tena aggi upalippati,
an5.192:14.9: evameva kho bho sabbakammehi cepi brāhmaṇo jīvikaṃ kappeti, na ca tena brāhmaṇo upalippati”.
an5.192:14.10: sabbakammehi jīvikaṃkappetīti kho doṇa tasmā brāhmaṇo “brāhmaṇa caṇḍālo”ti vuccati.
an5.192:14.11: evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇacaṇḍālo hoti.
an5.192:15.1: ye kho doṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo - mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesyañcidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti, tadanubhāsanti, bhāsitamanubhāsanti, sajjhāyitamanusajjhāyanti, vācitamanuvācenti, seyyathīdaṃ: aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu.
an5.192:15.3: brahmasamaṃ, devasamaṃ, mariyādaṃ, samhinnamariyādaṃ, brāhmaṇacaṇḍālaṃyeva pañcamaṃ.
an5.192:16.1: evaṃ sante mayaṃ bho gotama brāhmaṇacaṇḍālampi na purema.
an5.192:16.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama …pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
